items.title: Denzel Boston: Returns to practice Friday
items.text:

items.title: George Pickens: Trending toward Sunday return?
items.text:
Pickens (hamstring) moved well in Thursday's practice, which coach Brian Schottenheimer said is a positive sign for the wide receiver's availability for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

items.title: David Montgomery: Practices again Friday
